sloka: क्व चारण्यं क्व च क्षात्ऺत्र क्व जटा: क्व च पालनम् ।ईदृशं व्याहतं कर्म न भवान् कर्तुमर्हति ॥ २.१०६.१८॥
transliteration: kva cāraṇyaṁ kva ca kṣātऺtra kva jaṭā: kva ca pālanam ।īdṛśaṁ vyāhataṁ karma na bhavān kartumarhati ॥ 2.106.18॥

translations.english: Where is the forest and where is kshatriya's duty? Where are matted locks and where is governance of the kingdom? It does not behave you to do such acts antithetical to each other.
